live_section_text: How CTT started CTT began long before it had a name. Chloe started tutoring her younger brother and his friends when they were in Grade 4, inspired by her own experience at school. Traditional learning did not always work for her. She often had to come home and relearn entire concepts in a completely different way. With the help of her mom, learning became memorable. Mind maps, flashcards, funny sayings, shooting hoops while answering questions, and even learning during laps in the pool. That extra effort changed everything. Chloe knows what it feels like to struggle, to feel behind, and to wonder why something that seems easy for everyone else just will not click. But struggling does not mean a child is not capable. Sometimes, they simply have not been taught in the way they learn best. From a 60% student in her early school years to graduating as the top student in her university degree in 2025, Chloe made it her mission to help other learners discover what they are capable of. Ten years later, CTT is now a growing team across Gauteng, KwaZulu-Natal, and the Western Cape, with tutors studying or qualified in fields including engineering, architecture, accounting, psychology, marketing, and more. We understand the struggle. That is why we do what we do. No child is incapable, no child is ‘not smart enough’, and no child should feel less than because they learn differently. Sometimes, all it takes is the right person, the right explanation, and someone who refuses to give up on them. That is what CTT is here to be.
